description:
Simple Glide 500W Electric Trike – Your Own Personal Mobility Vehicle Has Arrived!

Experience a new level of independence and excitement with the Easy Rider Compact E Trike, the ultimate electric mobility vehicle designed for seniors, commuters, and mobility users alike. With its powerful 48V, 15Ah battery and 500W rear hub motor, this trike combines performance, comfort, and control — making every ride smooth, stable, and full of confidence. Whether you’re cruising city streets, running errands, or enjoying outdoor adventures, this electric trike for seniors delivers effortless freedom on three wheels.

Thrilling Performance:

Strap in for an electrifying mobility experience! The Easy Rider Compact E Trike packs a punch with its 48V, 15Ah battery and 500W rear hub motor, delivering the power seniors and mobility riders need for reliable performance. Whether you’re zipping through city streets or conquering gentle inclines, this electric mobility vehicle transforms your daily rides into safe, thrilling adventures.

Compact Dynamite:

Don’t let its size fool you — this trike is a compact powerhouse! Its streamlined frame enhances mobility and agility, allowing seniors and active adults to navigate tight corners, narrow pathways, and crowded spaces with ease. The Easy Rider Compact E Trike brings convenience and confidence wherever you go.

Smooth Operator:

Enjoy a truly smooth and stable ride. This mobility trike is engineered for maximum comfort, ensuring you glide effortlessly over rough terrain. Every ride feels balanced and controlled, so you can stay focused on the journey and not the bumps in the road.

Compact Agility:

Maneuverability is at the heart of this trike’s design. Its compact size makes it easy for seniors and mobility users to handle traffic, move through tight areas, or park conveniently — providing personal mobility freedom without the bulk of larger vehicles.

Comfort Redefined:

Your comfort is the priority. Designed with ergonomic seating, adjustable handlebars, and shock-absorbing tires, this electric mobility trike ensures a smooth, supportive ride wherever life takes you. Ideal for seniors or anyone seeking enhanced comfort, balance, and independence on three wheels.

Battery Compliant to the UL 2271 Standard as Tested by ACT Labs

The advanced rear differential on this 3 wheel ebike ensures power is distributed evenly to both rear wheels when pedaling. Turns on this e trike are smooth as butter and balanced. Both wheels in the rear will be getting power gluing the wheels to ground with unbelievable traction. Ultimately making turns on this 3 wheeled electric bike incredible safe and stable.

State-of-the-Art Rear Differential that Stabilizes the Rear Wheels and Creates a Safe Balanced Ride

Take Turns Knowing the Traction Will be Amazing Around Corners

All Three Tires Stayed Glued to Riding Surface

Ride Through Grass and Trails Easily with Both Rear Wheels Receiving Power
